text:
priya_mehta: Quick question — in the new /v1/usage response what's the canonical field we should use to reconcile customer billing? The schema currently has billed_units and chargeable_tokens and there's a cached_tokens field too. Which one should billing teams rely on?

kevin_lin: billed_units is the single-number answer for billing (units after any caching/quotas applied). chargeable_tokens is breakdown by prompt/completion at the same granularity. cached_tokens is informational (how many tokens were satisfied from KV/prefix cache) and should NOT be billed.

priya_mehta: ok thanks. One follow-up: when responses are streamed, I only see billed_units on the final event — do we emit chargeable_tokens per chunk? Customers doing per-chunk accounting are confused.

kevin_lin: streaming currently only emits a running billed_units counter on the final response object. we intentionally avoid per-chunk chargeable details to keep wire traffic small and deterministic. If you need per-chunk visibility, pass include_token_breakdown=true (opt-in) — that's behind a flag today.

marco_dev: to add, the server computes chargeable_tokens after cache deduction. so example: total_model_tokens=160, cached_tokens=40 -> chargeable_tokens.total=120 -> billed_units approx chargeable_tokens.total / tokens_per_unit. Example response we return (final event):
```json
{
  "billed_units": 2,
  "chargeable_tokens": {"prompt": 20, "completion": 100},
  "cached_tokens": 40,
  "model": "redwood-4o",
  "request_id": "r_01F..."
}
```

samuel: small doc nit — can we standardize the field name to chargeable_tokens.total in the next PR so downstreams don't have to sum prompt+completion? Right now some reconciliations miss the split and double-count. :eyes:

kevin_lin: agree that total is convenient. i've opened a tiny API-compat PR that adds chargeable_tokens.total and keeps the split (non-breaking). https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — will ship behind a feature flag for a couple weeks.

priya_mehta: perfect. for bookkeeping: billing will use billed_units for invoice generation, and we'll use chargeable_tokens.* for analytics and per-route cost attribution. We'll ignore cached_tokens for billing but keep it in telemetry. Thanks! :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy completed: usage-schema-v3 rolled out to canary (us-west-2) — 1765434920

marco_dev: FYI if anyone is working on SDKs — update to surface include_token_breakdown param and prefer chargeable_tokens.total when present. I'll add a note to the SDK changelog.

kevin_lin: i'll follow up in the API spec and add a short example in the /docs/usage page.

priya_mehta: cool, closing this thread unless someone has objections.
